fields.name: list
fields.why: List::clear_4734a0 0x004734a0 / the MessageList code: the object starts with the message DynArrayB (0x005857a0 linkin / 0x005858c0 linkout on this, 0x2e bytes on x86); x64: the list is 0x36 bytes, so ptr_2e .. i32_40 (the MESSAGE texture) move
